rationale: Both are thin and incomplete: neither clearly states the main alternative, revisit triggers, or real quantitative comparison across options. A gives a caveat about debate-first variance and a KPI tied to earned media, but little actionable why for the chosen sequence. B is slightly more decision-useful because its KPI better matches the launch goal (credible uptake, not just pickups) and its caveat more directly explains why validator-first matters for this kind of policy model. That gives a clearer causal reason for the recommended hybrid, even though comparative analysis remains weak in both.
